title: Earth-abundant metal catalysts for sustainable CO2 reduction: a review of strategies and progress
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01290B, Review Article
Jannatun Zia, Sivaprakasam Radhakrishnan, M. S. S. R. Tejaswini, Ufana Riaz
This review highlights catalyst design for CO2 reduction, focusing on active-site engineering, hybrid architectures, operando insights, and reactor integration to enable scalable, energy-efficient CO2 valorization.
